# HASK × HADocs Isolated Integration Pilot Final Report

## Executive Summary

The isolated adapter loads HASK contract 1.0.0 read-only and maps UniFi/MikroTik pilot evidence into candidate-only metadata without replacing HADocs Evidence, IncidentV2, scoring, reports or UI.

## Approved Baseline

Branch `main`, commit `590cc33a9762c4d22699f20c60d136ef2c4de00c`, plus 5 tracked and 21 untracked files was frozen by checksum and patch. Baseline tests: 216 passed. Existing HUDD work was preserved and not modified.

## Pilot Changes

New isolated config, loader, models, adapters, runner, fixtures, tests, generator and reports were added. There is no production scan hook. Feature default is disabled.

## Results

UniFi: `candidate_only`. MikroTik: `candidate_only`. Provenance, missing evidence, applicability, conflicts/gaps and verification remain in candidate metadata. Confirmed candidates: zero. Health Score impact: none.

## Failure tests and regression status

Sixteen pilot tests cover disabled mode, missing path, manifest/version/checksum/file/reference failures, additive fields, unknown/no-match/unavailable semantics, conflicts, partial verification, deduplication, read-only access and both vertical slices. Baseline: 216 passed. Final and clean-copy regression: 232 passed. Pilot report double-build SHA-256 differences: zero. All 26 approved baseline file checksums remained unchanged.

## Version compatibility

HADocs runtime `0.15.0-rc1` (manifest SemVer base `0.15.0`), Python 3.14.3, branch `main`, commit above, tested 2026-07-24. Package metadata `0.11.1` and exporter default `0.12.0` remain documented baseline divergences. Contract major 1 is supported by the pilot.

## Production readiness

The pilot proves the adapter boundary, not production readiness. Permanent installation/update, signature trust, normal-scan evidence mapping, report/API/UI exposure and score policy require a separately approved Production Integration Phase 1. Existing version-marker divergence (`0.11.1`, `0.12.0`, `0.15.0-rc1`) and pytest configuration drift remain baseline maintenance risks.
